meta.repo_description: qb-sandbox — self-contained JS utility library, node:test, ~60 tests
meta.author: Velora / Quarterback project
meta.note: repo path is relative to QB root — resolved at runtime

tasks.description: Add a clamp(n, min, max) function to src/utils.js that returns n clamped to the range [min, max]. Export it.
oracle_tests: clamp returns value when in range

tasks.description: Add a compact(arr) function to src/utils.js that removes all falsy values from an array and returns the filtered result. Export it.
oracle_tests: compact returns empty array for all-falsy input

tasks.description: Add a capitalize(str) function to src/formatter.js that returns the string with the first letter uppercased and the rest lowercased. Export it.
Add a formatBytes(bytes, decimals=1) function to src/formatter.js that formats a byte count as a human-readable string: '0 B' for 0, '1.5 KB' for 1536, '1.0 MB' for 1048576, etc. Export it.
Add an isEmail(str) function to src/validator.js that returns true if str looks like a valid email (contains @, has characters before @, has a . after @). Export it.
oracle_tests: isEmail returns true for valid email
isEmail returns false for invalid email

tasks.description: Add a parseIntSafe(str, fallback=0) function to src/parser.js that parses an integer from a string, returning the fallback if the input is not a string or results in NaN. Export it.
Add a getLevel() method to the object returned by createLogger in src/logger.js that returns the current log level string.
Add a keys() method to the object returned by createCache in src/cache.js that returns an array of all non-expired cache keys.
Add a debounce(fn, ms) function to src/utils.js that returns a debounced version of fn — it delays invocation until ms milliseconds have passed since the last call (trailing edge). Export it.
oracle_tests: debounce resets timer on repeated calls

tasks.description: Add a throttle(fn, ms) function to src/utils.js that returns a throttled version of fn — it fires immediately on the first call (leading edge) and suppresses subsequent calls within the ms window. Export it.
oracle_tests: throttle calls fn immediately on first call
throttle allows call after window expires

tasks.description: Add a formatPercent(n, decimals=1) function to src/formatter.js that formats a number in [0,1] as a percentage string like '42.5%'. Input 0.5 should produce '50.0%'. Export it.

Add a parseCSVTable(csv) function to src/parser.js that parses a multi-line CSV string where the first row is headers. Returns an array of plain objects keyed by header names. Use the existing parseCSVLine function internally. Export it.
Add an isURL(str) function to src/validator.js that returns true if str starts with 'http://' or 'https://' and has a valid-looking hostname. Returns false for null/undefined/non-string. Export it.
oracle_tests: isURL returns true for http URL

tasks.description: Add a validateRequired(data, fields) function to src/validator.js that checks all listed fields exist and are not null/undefined/empty-string. Returns { valid: boolean, missing: string[] }. Export it.
oracle_tests: validateRequired returns valid when all fields present

tasks.description: Add a once(event, fn) method to the object returned by createEmitter in src/events.js that registers fn as a one-time listener: it fires exactly once and is automatically removed after the first emission.
oracle_tests: once listener is removed after firing

tasks.description: Add a getStats() method to the object returned by createCache in src/cache.js that returns { size, hits, misses }. Modify the existing get() to track hits (found, not expired) and misses (not found or expired).

Add formatBytes(bytes, decimals=1) to src/formatter.js (exported) AND add a getSizeReport() method to createCache in src/cache.js. getSizeReport must require('./formatter') to use formatBytes and return a string like '3 entries, 1.2 KB' (summing JSON.stringify length of all non-expired values).
oracle_tests: getSizeReport returns string with entry count

tasks.description: Add memoize(fn, keyResolver) to src/utils.js (exported) that caches fn results by argument key (uses JSON.stringify if no keyResolver). AND add getOrSet(key, factory, ttl) method to createCache in src/cache.js — returns cached value if present, otherwise calls factory(), stores the result, and returns it.
oracle_tests: memoize returns different results for different args
getOrSet stores and returns factory result
getOrSet returns cached value without calling factory again

tasks.description: Add once(event, fn) to createEmitter in src/events.js AND add a pipe(targetEmitter) method. pipe() registers forwarding listeners on all currently-known events. The existing on() must also register pipe-forwarding listeners for new events added after pipe() is called.
oracle_tests: once listener is removed after firing
pipe forwards events to target emitter
pipe does not affect direct listeners

tasks.description: Extend validateSchema in src/validator.js to support nested object schemas: if a field's rule is { type: 'object', schema: {...} }, recursively validate the nested object. Errors should use dot-notation paths like 'address.city must be a string'.
oracle_tests: validateSchema validates nested object with sub-schema
validateSchema reports nested errors with dot notation
